Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command '
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
$size = 256
$extent = 0.94
$strokeRatio = 0.145
$halfStroke = $extent * $strokeRatio * 0.5
$radius = $extent - $halfStroke * 2
$bmp = New-Object System.Drawing.Bitmap\($size, $size\)
$bg = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb\(255, 4, 10, 19\)
$fg = [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb\(255, 136, 0, 21\)
function EdgeDistance\([double]$px, [double]$py, [double]$startAngle\) {
  $min = [double]::MaxValue
  for \($i = 0; $i -lt 3; $i++\) {
    $a0 = \($startAngle + $i * 120\) * [Math]::PI / 180
    $a1 = \($startAngle + \($i + 1\) * 120\) * [Math]::PI / 180
    $sx = [Math]::Cos\($a0\) * $radius; $sy = [Math]::Sin\($a0\) * $radius
    $ex = [Math]::Cos\($a1\) * $radius; $ey = [Math]::Sin\($a1\) * $radius
    $dx = $ex - $sx; $dy = $ey - $sy
    $nx = -$dy; $ny = $dx
    $len = [Math]::Sqrt\($nx*$nx + $ny*$ny\)
    $nx = $nx / $len; $ny = $ny / $len
    $d = \($px - $sx\) * $nx + \($py - $sy\) * $ny
    if \($d -lt $min\) { $min = $d }
  }
  return $min
}
$samples = 4
for \($y = 0; $y -lt $size; $y++\) {
  for \($x = 0; $x -lt $size; $x++\) {
    $alpha = 0.0
    for \($sy = 0; $sy -lt $samples; $sy++\) {
      for \($sx = 0; $sx -lt $samples; $sx++\) {
        $px = \(\($x + \($sx + 0.5\) / $samples\) / $size\) * 2 - 1
        $py = \(\($y + \($sy + 0.5\) / $samples\) / $size\) * 2 - 1
        $a = EdgeDistance $px $py 90
        $b = EdgeDistance $px $py 270
        $coverA = [Math]::Min\(1, [Math]::Max\(0, \($halfStroke - [Math]::Abs\($a\)\) / \(2.0 / $size\) + 0.5\)\)
        $coverB = [Math]::Min\(1, [Math]::Max\(0, \($halfStroke - [Math]::Abs\($b\)\) / \(2.0 / $size\) + 0.5\)\)
        $cover = [Math]::Max\($coverA, $coverB\)
        $alpha += $cover
      }
    }
    $alpha = $alpha / \($samples * $samples\)
    $r = [int]\($bg.R + \($fg.R - $bg.R\) * $alpha\)
    $g = [int]\($bg.G + \($fg.G - $bg.G\) * $alpha\)
    $b = [int]\($bg.B + \($fg.B - $bg.B\) * $alpha\)
    $bmp.SetPixel\($x, $y, [System.Drawing.Color]::FromArgb\(255, $r, $g, $b\)\)
  }
}
$out = "C:\\Users\\JUNGLE\\.qoder\\tmp\\hexa_shape_preview.png"
$bmp.Save\($out, [System.Drawing.Imaging.ImageFormat]::Png\)
$bmp.Dispose\(\)
Write-Output "saved $out"
')
